answer_1.quote: We synthesize 315 codeswitching queries to demonstrate the effectiveness of the CSRT attack and examine both the safety and the multilingual capabilities of LLMs...

answer_2.quote: We adopt three metrics to assess the response quality of LLMs on the CSRT benchmark: attack success rate (ASR), refusal rate (RR), and comprehension (Cmp.). All metrics are computed using gpt-4o.

answer_3.quote: All metrics are computed using gpt-4o. ... we use gpt-4o as a judge to evaluate ASR, RR, and Cmp. scores of model responses.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 120 samples ... one author of this paper manually evaluates the response quality of the same 120 samples. Table shows the correlation between human judgment and LLM predictions across three rubrics.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotator judged each response on three rubrics: attack success, refusal, and comprehension.
